10:1.text: [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings]
. These are the Verses of the Book

10:2.text: Is it a wonder for mankind that We have sent Our Revelation
to a man from among themselves
(i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
, and give good news to those who believe
(in the Oneness of Allâh and in His Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
that they shall have with their Lord the rewards of their good deeds?"
the disbelievers say: "This is indeed an evident sorcerer
(i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân)

10:3.text: Surely, your Lord is Allâh Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days and then rose over
(really in a manner that suits His Majesty)
, disposing the affair of all things. No intercessor
except after His Leave. That is Allâh, your Lord; so worship Him

10:4.text: To Him is the return of all of you. The Promise of Allâh is true. It is He Who begins the creation and then will repeat it, that He may reward with justice those who believed
(in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
and did deeds of righteousness. But those who disbelieved will have a drink of boiling fluids and painful torment because they used to disbelieve.

10:5.text: It is He Who made the sun a shining thing and the moon as a light and measured out for it stages that you might know the number of years and the reckoning. Allâh did not create this but in truth. He explains the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
in detail for people who have knowledge.

10:6.text: Verily, in the alternation of the night and the day and in all that Allâh has created in the heavens and the earth are Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
for those people who keep their duty to Allâh, and fear Him much.
